interface_detail: A web index with a custom newznab-style interface per a listing; the same listing says there is no API.
tooling: No API is reported, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot add it; a wrapper would drive the web pages. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: A manual fallback; 2 NZBs per day, or one per day and a half, makes it a last-resort grab.
